messages:
zoe-fin: Quick FYI — noticed a gap in EU metering: ~480k embed requests during last night's window are missing from the ledger. Appears correlated with the rate-limiter drop on eu-central aggregator.

mike-eng: yikes. any clue if they were dropped or routed to a test sku?

jia-infra: digging in logs now. proxy shows 503s for a short period, and the ingest worker retried but an edge bug caused requests to be swallowed before enrichment. I see ~480,123 request_ids with no embed_events written.

zoe-fin: estimated customer impact: two customers hit hardest — GreenTree ~210k, NimbusAI ~150k, misc ~120k. At current embed price rough under-bill ~$1,920.

billing-bot: Metering anomaly detected for acct_GT (GreenTree) and acct_NA (NimbusAI). Tickets #INC-2401 and #INC-2402 opened.

mike-eng: fix is in flight: PR to harden retry path and prevent swallow merged to main (commit d4e9f1). Will deploy canary now.

jia-infra: mitigation plan: 1) deploy fix to canary and prod 2) run backfill job to ingest missing events from request logs 3) reconcile metering and create adjustment CSV for billing ops.

zoe-fin: request: finance approval to post provisional credits to GreenTree and NimbusAI while backfill runs. Proposed provisional total $1,920. We'll reconcile and invoice or reverse after backfill.

ana-finance: Approve provisional credits up to $1,920. Please add invoice note: "Provisional credit pending ingestion backfill verification." Billing ops to perform manual adjustment when csv is ready.

leo-sales: I'll tell GreenTree and NimbusAI we're issuing a provisional credit and investigating. Keep message brief and non-alarmist. :thumbsup:

jia-infra: starting backfill job now (job_id: backfill-eu-1742156789). ETA ~2.5h. Will upload replay diff to s3://redwood-billing/replays/1742156789-backfill.csv

mike-eng: monitor canary deploy; if stable will push to prod in 30m.

billing-bot: Backfill job scheduled: backfill-eu-1742156789. Will post completion link here.

zoe-fin: thanks everyone. Once backfill diff is in, billing ops please consume the csv and apply provisional adjustments. Finance will reconcile in the next billing cycle.
